basic_details.job_title: ECIL ITI Trade Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 310 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Electronics Corporation of India Limited (ECIL) is inviting online applications for the engagement of ITI Trade Apprentices at ECIL Hyderabad, under the Apprenticeship Act 1961. The apprenticeship tenure is one year, commencing from 02 November 2026. Register for Job Alerts

how_to_apply: ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Apply Online process involves two mandatory steps — registration on the MSDE Apprenticeship portal, followed by submission of the application on the ECIL website.

Step 1: Interested candidates who possess the required educational qualification must first register themselves on the website www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE).
Step 2: After registering on the MSDE portal, eligible candidates must submit the online application through the ECIL website: https://www.ecil.co.in → 'Human Resources' → 'Current Job Openings'.
Applications submitted only through the ECIL website shall be accepted and considered; MSDE portal registration alone is not sufficient.
The online application process will be operational from 30.09.2026 (18:00 hrs) to 11.10.2026 (23:59 hrs).
After applying online, take a printout of the registered online application form with the system-generated application number, and note down the application number for all future references.
A re-print of the registered online application form can be taken before the last date for online registration.
Quote the system-generated application number for all future correspondence with ECIL; all correspondence will be communicated only through the email furnished in the online application form.

content_sections.heading: ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 310 seats have been notified across 13 ITI trades. Out of the 310 seats, 16 seats would be horizontally reserved for PWD candidates. ECIL reserves the right to increase or decrease the notified vacancies/seats based on need.

content_sections.heading: ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold an ITI Pass Certificate, i.e., an NCVT certificate, in the respective trade applied for. All qualifications should be from Indian Institutes recognized by the appropriate Statutory Authority. Only candidates residing in all districts of Telangana State are eligible to apply. Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing Apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act 1961 in any Government, PSU, or Private Organization are not eligible to apply. The Degree of Disability for PWD candidates must be 40% and above.

content_sections.heading: ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should not be less than 18 years of age as on 31.10.2026.

rows.upper_age_limit: Additional 10 years relaxation over and above the applicable category limit

content_sections.heading: ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected based on ITI marks merit. 70% of seats will be engaged with Government ITI students, and 30% of seats with Private ITI students. The date of verification of original documents will be intimated by email to candidates in due course; candidates are required to attend document verification within short notice. Electronics Corporation of India Limited, Corporate Learning & Development Centre (CLDC), Nalanda Complex, TIFR Road, ECIL, Hyderabad – 500062. Phone no.: 04027186454/2279. Candidates called for document verification must present the following original documents mandatorily, along with a set of photocopies: Online registered application form, duly signed by the candidate, with a recent colour passport-size photo affixed. All original certificates in support of MSDE Registration, date of birth, identity (Government-issued only, such as Aadhaar, Driving License, Passport, etc.), Educational Qualification, and latest Caste & Disability (PWD) certificates (wherever applicable), along with a set of photocopies. Category Certificate in support of SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS, in the prescribed proforma hosted on www.ecil.co.in. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Document Verification. Only after passing a practical test to determine proficiency in the designated trade, on completion of the training period, will the National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) be issued by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Apply Online process involves two mandatory steps — registration on the MSDE Apprenticeship portal, followed by submission of the application on the ECIL website. Step 1: Interested candidates who possess the required educational qualification must first register themselves on the website www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE). Step 2: After registering on the MSDE portal, eligible candidates must submit the online application through the ECIL website: https://www.ecil.co.in → 'Human Resources' → 'Current Job Openings'. Applications submitted only through the ECIL website shall be accepted and considered; MSDE portal registration alone is not sufficient. The online application process will be operational from 30.09.2026 (18:00 hrs) to 11.10.2026 (23:59 hrs). After applying online, take a printout of the registered online application form with the system-generated application number, and note down the application number for all future references. A re-print of the registered online application form can be taken before the last date for online registration. Quote the system-generated application number for all future correspondence with ECIL; all correspondence will be communicated only through the email furnished in the online application form.

faq.question: Q1. What is ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification (Advertisement No. 11/2026 dated 30.09.2026) issued by Electronics Corporation of India Limited (ECIL) for engagement of ITI Trade Apprentices at ECIL Hyderabad under the Apprenticeship Act 1961, for a one-year apprenticeship period, offering a total of 310 seats across 13 trades.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 310 seats are available across 13 trades, including Fitter (87), Electronics Mechanic (86), Electrician (50), Computer Operator and Programming Assistant (41), Welder (16), and others. Out of 310 seats, 16 are horizontally reserved for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process is operational from 30.09.2026 (18:00 hrs) to 11.10.2026 (23:59 hrs).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: Candidates need an ITI Pass Certificate, i.e., an NCVT certificate, in the respective trade applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should not be less than 18 years of age as on 31.10.2026. The upper age limit is 25 years for General candidates, 28 years for OBC, and 30 years for SC/ST, with an additional 10 years' relaxation for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a domicile requirement for ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, only candidates residing in all districts of Telangana State are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (MSDE portal), and then submit their online application through the ECIL website (https://www.ecil.co.in → Human Resources → Current Job Openings) between 30.09.2026 and 11.10.2026. Applications submitted only through the ECIL website will be accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ECIL ITI Trade Apprentice?
faq.answer: Selection is based on ITI marks merit, with 70% of seats engaged with Government ITI students and 30% with Private ITI students, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. When will the ECIL ITI Trade Apprenticeship training commence?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training is scheduled to commence on 02.11.2026, for a tenure of one year.
